chunks: And whatever is in it from Jaʿfar ibn ʿUthmān, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Mūsā al-Kamandānī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abū Jaʿfar al-Shāmī, from Jaʿfar ibn ʿUthmān.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jaʿfar ibn ʿUthmān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Jaʿfar ibn ʿUthmān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith preservation and source verification.
